verdicts.tldr: The 'List your package' command on the Build page fails as written: it runs out of gas, and it signs for chain ID 'dev'.
verdicts.details: The store-claim snippet in define "store/list-your-package" ends `-gas-fee 1000000ugnot -gas-wanted 20000000 -broadcast -remote RPC KEY` with no -chainid. gnokey maketx defaults -chainid to "dev" (tm2/pkg/crypto/keys/client/maketx.go:123-124), so any other chain rejects the signature. Claim also costs about 25.6M gas on a fresh chain, above the 20M the snippet allows. newTemplates only passes storePkg/domain/storeURL (template.go:19-25), so this template cannot fill ChainId and Remote the way ui/command.html does. The page offers no other way to list a package, so a namespace owner who copies it never gets listed. Fix: raise -gas-wanted (for example 50000000, or use -simulate) and add `-chainid CHAINID` as a placeholder, or pass the configured ChainId and Remote into the store templates and print them as command.html does.
verdicts.evidence: Head, finder's txtar rerun in a scratch worktree: step 1 (snippet flags + -chainid=tendermint_test) 'GAS WANTED: 20000000 / GAS USED: 25606611 / Data: out of gas error'; step 2 (-gas-wanted 40000000, no -chainid) 'signature verification failed; verify correct account, sequence, and chain-id'; step 3 (both fixed) 'OK! GAS WANTED: 40000000 GAS USED: 25606591'; '--- PASS: TestTestdata', 'ok gno.land/pkg/integration 2.226s'. Base: gno.land/pkg/gnoweb/feature/store does not exist at the merge base, so the snippet and realm are new in this diff.

verdicts.verify_by: Render the home page with b5-lines-reach-catalog-render_test.go, then run xvfb-run -a node b5-lines-reach-catalog-css-probe.mjs <html> <shots>. Expect P2.spotlight.container 'overflow-x auto overflow-y auto' with clipped {top,bottom,left} all true, P2.categoryPill clipped top and left true, and the shelf baseline overflow visible.
verdicts.tldr: Below 1020px a keyboard user cannot see which Spotlight card has focus, and the category pills' focus ring loses its top and left edges.
verdicts.details: .b-store-grid--spotlight sets overflow-x: auto (store.css:708) and has no padding, so overflow-y computes to auto and the scroll box clips. The card's ring, `outline: var(--s-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px` on .b-store-card:has(h3 a:focus-visible) (275-279), sits 2-4px outside the card, and the link's own outline is off (441-443). Only the @media (--xl) block puts overflow-x back to visible. The category strip is a .c-reel (built main.css `.c-reel{display:flex;overflow:scroll}`) with padding only at block-end (store.css:161), so the 'All' pill's ring is cut at the top and left at every width. Fix: give both scroll containers at least 4px of padding, using scroll-padding to keep snapping aligned, or draw the ring inset (negative outline-offset) inside them.
verdicts.evidence: Head: rendered the home fixture with the finder's render test against the committed main.css (which contains `b-store-grid--spotlight{...overflow-x:auto...}`), then reran the probe under xvfb with system Chromium. Output: spotlight {focused 'Trusted Two', focusVisible true, container 'overflow-x auto overflow-y auto', ringOutside top 644 bottom 951.6 left 36, clip top 648 bottom 947.6 left 40, clipped top/bottom/left true}; categoryPill {focused 'All', container 'overflow-x scroll overflow-y scroll padding-top 0px', clipped top true left true}. My own p2-spotlight.png shows only the ring's right edge, in green, beside 'Trusted Two'. p2-category-pill.png shows the 'All' ring with no top or left edge. The shelf row's 'clipped' flags are geometric only: that container is overflow visible and does not clip. Base: the store frontend does not exist at the merge base.

verdicts.verify_by: Run P1 of b5-lines-reach-catalog-css-probe.mjs at 1280px. Expect spanHovered false and hit 'A' for spotlightCardTrust, shelfCommunity and shelfPath, against spanHovered true for heroTrust.
verdicts.tldr: On every card, hovering the trust badge, the 'community' label or the shortened path shows no tooltip, so card visitors never see those title= explanations.
verdicts.details: The card is position: relative (store.css:340). `h3 a::after { position: absolute; inset: 0 }` (434-439) lays the link over the whole card. The only rule that lifts content above it is `.b-store-meta a { position: relative; z-index: var(--g-z-1) }` (592-594). .trust (605), .community and the ShortPath span (parts.html:26, 33, 44) get no z-index, so the pointer lands on the <a> and the title never shows. The visible label text stays, and the detail page shows the same community tag and full path with no overlay (pages.html:35-36), so only the hover explanation on cards is lost. That makes it a Nit, not a Warning. Fix: give `.b-store-card :is(.trust, .community, .path [title])` position: relative and z-index var(--g-z-1), the way .b-store-meta a already has.
